evaluator_note: Static review only (tests not run by instruction); test results are executor-reported.

tests_pass.note: executor-reported green; full make test unconfirmed; static review only

acceptance_criteria.note: AC4, AC5, AC6, AC8, AC9, AC10, AC14a, AC15 and console parts of AC7 met; AC6/NT3 hold test sets map._holding directly; no direct test of the consoles' armed-confirm Esc

code_quality.note: see findings; focus() does not restore pullback or close a previously focused station

documentation.note: execution notes 7-14, changelog and sprint progress accurate; note 10 departs from design C4 (cancel not confirmed) and is disclosed

design_fidelity.note: D-56/D-57 Q2-Q6 honoured; helm panel hides the 3D console; map side panel clipped

findings.issue: focus() sets camera.pullback = 0 and records _eye.pullback but leave() never restores it, so a player in third-person pullback loses it after any console use.

use(other, 'open') while a station is already focused calls focus() without closing the old panel (_close_panel not called), leaving the helm window or codex open. The player path (click/E) is blocked while focused, but the M4.5 bot calls use() directly.
findings.suggestion: In use('open'), if focused != '' and focused != id, call leave() or _close_panel(focused) first; add a test.

findings.issue: NT3 hold-release test drives map._holding/hold_commit directly, not the commit_button or hold_button path; the consoles' confirm Esc back-out in twice mode is also only tested for the map, not for confirm_button (Approach/Leave/Begin).
findings.suggestion: Add button_down/up emit cases for the map hold button and an escape() case on an armed ShipConsoles confirm.

findings.issue: The sweep closes any console right after each event, so no keys are tried with a console focused (fine for NT1) but also no HUD buttons (Tab panel, card buttons) are clicked; 'HUD element' coverage rests on the mouse positions at 4 fixed points. Sgr A* approach intents tagged 'tick' are not asserted.
findings.suggestion: Also emit pressed on every visible Button under ship_hud (Tab panel, tour card) and assert no player decision.

findings.issue: _replan_body_commit now re-plans on 'moved' for star plans too; correct and found by the GPU check, but there is no headless test pinning stale_plan on a star plan held >1.5 s.
findings.suggestion: Add a test: plan a star, advance host ticks, commit; assert no stale_plan refusal.

findings.issue: At 1280x720 the helm panel hides the 3D console entirely (the dolly is not visible) and the map side panel's footer text is clipped. Voyage render shows the idle-screen slab floating over the console top.
findings.suggestion: PR 3 U7: leave a visible console margin or check the 2560x1440 render; tidy panel footer.

findings.issue: Execution note 10: cancel is a single click, but design C4 and Q6 listed cancel-transit as a confirmed action. Reasoned (sim refuses cancel once committed) and disclosed, but Mark has not ruled.
findings.suggestion: Record in the PR description as a decision for Mark.

checks.no_decision_without_console: Verified by reading: N/L/C keys removed; map plan/commit/cancel/speed paths all gated by planning() (helm and not guided); tick() drops pending when not planning; Sgr A* entry, Approach, Leave, Begin, Archive reachable only via use() with focus; main.gd:105 is the title-screen route (outside NT1 scope).
checks.chart_never_plans: Yes: preselect, plan_target, plan_body, plan_home, set_cruise_phi, open_commit_dialog, hold_commit, press_cancel all guard on planning(); set_mode('chart') clears _pending and closes the dialog; test_chart asserts an empty player intent log.
checks.esc_order: armed confirm, console, codex, Tab panel, I card, arrival, menu/quit: matches note 14.
checks.mutation: NT1 mutation (N/C rebind) reported by executor; plausible against the sweep.

summary: Solid PR. All console ACs are implemented and the gating of decisions behind planning()/focus is consistent; chart mode never plans; confirm, Walk to, click-to-walk and the dolly are sound, with deterministic fake-clock tests. Weaknesses are minor: pullback not restored after leaving a console, use('open') not closing a previously focused station (bot path), a few thin test paths (direct _holding poke, HUD buttons not swept), and the 720p helm render hides the console. Score 84, pass.
